Four P3: nonexistent Mathlib name Int.exists_two_mul_abs_sub_mul_le (use abs_sub_round), TS 2A mislocator for the dual, dependency-table rows 4.10/6.3/6.4 disagree with Needs lines, DSV p.2 cited for a rationality statement it does not contain.
